No, you can't. You can't activate a [Main] effect at the same time as another effect.

Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Main] effect at the same time as an effect such as P-103 [Offense Training]'s effect that digivolves?

Effect: [Security] You may play 1 Digimon card with 2000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[Main] By suspending this Digimon, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
[All Turns] This Digimon can't attack or block.
[On Deletion] Place this card as the top security card.
